question: What BERT models are used?
title: EmotionX-IDEA: Emotion BERT -- an Affectional Model for Conversation
answer_rationale: Text 5 explicitly states that the authors adapted BERT and derived two models, namely FriendsBERT and ChatBERT, for pre-training before formal training. Text 4 and Text 9 further confirm that these models are adaptations of BERT for the specific task, making them the BERT models used in the document.
